They are worn by members of the [[Jade Brotherhood]]. ==Acquisition== * [[Guild Wars Factions|Factions]] ** [[Kaineng City]] *** [[Jade Brotherhood]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Jade Bracelet#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming===
====[[Tahnnakai Temple (explorable area)]]==== [[File:Jade Bracelets Farming (Tahnnakai Temple).jpg|150px]] * Start from [[Zin Ku Corridor]] and head north. * Enemies consist of [[Temple Guardian]]s before the blue line. * All enemies encountered after the blue line are [[Jade Brotherhood]].
====[[Xaquang Skyway]]==== [[File:Jade Bracelets Farming (Xaquang Skyway).jpg|250px]] * Start from [[Senji's Corner]] and head north. * Re-zone via [[the Undercity]] and then continue west. * All enemies encountered are Jade Brotherhood.
====[[Wajjun Bazaar]]==== [[File:Jade Bracelets Farming (Wajjun Bazaar).jpg|250px]] * Start from [[the Marketplace]] and head west along the shore. * Head counter-clockwise across the northern island. * All enemies encountered are Jade Brotherhood.
